Research Update

Andy CASA, UCL East

Its been a few weeks since the last post. I'm currently working on a new map for University College London, images will be placed online shortly. The Woodberry Down Regeneration Site is looking like its about to be back up and running. A full run down so far can be seen in Chapter 8 of the Thesis which can be downloaded from the main page.



Finally, the Virtual World work is featured on the BBC World Service 'Go Digital'. You can listen to the webcast, which includes images from the work, and more importantly music from Dr Who, here. There seems to be bug in the webcast, so there is no sound until 3 minutes into the show. The interview can be found between 8 and 14 minutes.
